meta.name: Prompt Enhancer for text to image (Qwen3-VL 4B)
meta.licenseNote: Qwen3-VL-4B is Apache-2.0 (Alibaba Qwen, 2025-10); the file is the one Krea 2's templates use as their text encoder. The app ships no weights.
meta.notes: Prompt expansion without a picture, as ComfyUI's official Krea 2 template does it: TextGenerate on the Qwen3-VL 4B encoder with the engine's instructions as the system turn (`system`) and the user's idea as the user turn (`prompt`), temperature 0.3, at most 220 tokens (about 1.5–2 s on the 5090). PreviewAny reports the paragraph in the history. `thinking` is true on purpose (see enhance/edit: the node's thinking=false appends an empty <think> block this non-thinking Instruct model cannot follow). The engine also uses this graph to rewrite an edit instruction blind when no picture is given.
meta.creator: Alibaba Qwen
meta.description: Expands an idea into a detailed prompt with the Qwen3-VL 4B encoder
